content.short: Securitize is a leading RWA compliance platform that tokenizes institutional funds including BlackRock's BUIDL.
content.description: Securitize is the definitive compliance-focused platform for the issuance, management, and trading of tokenized real-world assets (RWAs). As a FINRA-compliant broker-dealer and transfer agent, the platform provides institutional-grade infrastructure for moving traditional financial instruments—such as private equity, venture capital, and US Treasuries—onto the blockchain. Securitize is the primary technology partner for major institutions, most notably powering BlackRock's BUIDL fund. The platform simplifies the complex legal and technical requirements of digital securities.
content.meta: Securitize provides institutional-grade RWA tokenization and compliance infrastructure. Discover Securitize and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
